verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an inference cloud whose evidence covers OpenAI-compatible chat completions, embeddings and RAG building blocks, and model hosting. Nothing documents an in-product feature that analyzes the user's own data (usage, logs, account data) and surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions. The inference APIs are developer building blocks a user could use to construct such a feature, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
